data.change_summary: Implemented the remaining budget-guard remediation in `tank_core`. `CleanFilter` no longer deletes microbial N/C: the removed decomposer/AOB/NOB/comammox biomass is now rerouted into dissolved organic nitrogen/carbon using the same live-biomass stoichiometry as the rest of the conservation system, so `action:clean_filter` records gross in/out with near-zero net drift and is treated as a closed-system internal transfer instead of an implicit export. I also tightened the tracked-tick guard so open-system suppression now depends on non-zero per-element `BudgetEntry.delta` flux rather than action labels alone; no-op `Feed`, `WaterChangePercent`, `SiphonDetritus`, `AddShrimp`, and `RemoveShrimp` entries no longer disable the nitrogen/carbon conservation check, and carbon open/closed classification now keys off carbon flux directly. Added regression coverage for the new CleanFilter routing and for the no-op/element-specific guard behavior.
outstanding_risks: The structural canonical-helper coverage guard is still convention-based rather than reflective; future explicit N/C-bearing fields with non-standard names or fields hidden in empty-by-default collections will require extending the discovery rules and tests.

Shrimp eggs remain implicit until hatch; mass is conserved by debiting dissolved pools on hatch and maturation, but a future phase may still want an explicit egg or clutch biomass pool for clearer persistence and tracing.

Complex multi-process stages such as `system:nitrogen_cycle` still rely on snapshot-derived gross component budgets, so same-component turnover inside a single pass can remain collapsed until those stages emit fully explicit source/sink deltas.

steps.description: Audit the remaining amendments against the current budget guard and `CleanFilter` action to confirm where mass was still disappearing and where no-op open-system actions could incorrectly suppress the closed-tick checks.

Patch `CleanFilter` so removed microbial biomass is routed into dissolved organics instead of vanishing, and update the closed-system nitrogen/carbon guard helpers to treat only non-zero external per-element budget fluxes as open-system behavior.

Add regression coverage for conserved `CleanFilter` routing in `budget_tracking` plus engine unit tests that prove no-op open-system actions stay closed and that carbon open/closed classification follows carbon flux rather than action labels alone.
Run focused and full-package validation to confirm the amended budget guard and filter-cleaning routing pass without regressing broader `tank_core` behavior.

validation_evidence: `cargo test -p tank_core --test budget_tracking` passed (18 tests, including the new `test_clean_filter_routes_removed_microbes_to_dissolved_organics`).
`cargo test -p tank_core --test cycling` passed (12 tests, preserving the existing filter-cleaning and cycling regressions).
`cargo test -p tank_core` passed across the full `tank_core` suite, including the new engine unit tests for no-op open-system actions and element-specific closed-system guard behavior.
